sent.description: USB-C power adapter 70 W, external AC to DC power supply for information technology equipment, input 100-240 V AC, USB Power Delivery output 5 V to 20.6 V DC

questions.question: What does the device do (e.g. generate or convert electric power, produce heat, or transmit or receive communications)?
questions.why: Headings within chapter 85 split by function (motors and generators, transformers, switching or protecting apparatus, communication apparatus, domestic appliances).

candidates.rationale: An AC/DC power adapter is an electrical static converter (rectifier/transformer) of subheading 8504 40. It matches precedents P1-P3 for AC 100-240 V to DC USB chargers.

evidence.excerpt:
Headings 8501 to 8504 do not apply to goods described in heading 8511 , 8512 , 8540 , 8541 or 8542 .

However, metal tank mercury arc rectifiers remain classified in heading 8504 .

title.en: Electrical inductors; n.e.c. in heading no. 8504

candidates.rationale: Heading 8504 also covers inductors, but the product's essential function is conversion of AC to DC, not inductance.
candidates.set_aside_reason: The product is a complete converter, not an inductor.

title.en: Electrical apparatus; plugs and sockets, for a voltage not exceeding 1000 volts

candidates.rationale: Plugs and sockets of 8536 69 cover only connecting devices, which the adapter is not. It contains conversion circuitry.
candidates.set_aside_reason: Precedents P4-P5 are passive plug adaptors with no conversion, unlike this active converter.

title.en: Automatic data processing machines; comprising in the same housing at least a central processing unit and an input and output unit, whether or not combined, n.e.c. in item no. 8471.30

candidates.rationale: 8471 41 covers complete ADP machines, which a power supply is not.
candidates.set_aside_reason: It is not a data processing machine, just an external power accessory.

title.en: Electrical apparatus; switches n.e.c. in heading no. 8536, for a voltage not exceeding 1000 volts

candidates.rationale: 8536 50 covers switches, and the adapter performs no switching function as its principal role.
candidates.set_aside_reason: It is not a switch; conversion is its essential function.
